subject: reading
title: Word detective
blurb: Use the sentence to work out the word.

items.prompt: The soup was scalding, so she waited for it to cool. What does “scalding” mean?
The path was so narrow that only one person could pass. What does “narrow” mean?
He felt weary after the long walk and sat down to rest. What does “weary” mean?
The ancient ruins were thousands of years old. What does “ancient” mean?
She spoke in a faint whisper we could barely hear. What does “faint” mean?
